A deacon, with Deacon Malachi beside him, works through the stumbling block that Romans 11 has become in Israel: who the Gentiles, the strangers and the wild olive tree really are. The class starts from the command to love your brother, traces how Ephraim became 'not a people' in Hosea and Isaiah, shows the builders appointed to reject the stone so Christ could die for both houses, and ends in Ephesians 2, where the aliens and strangers who were far off are made nigh and the two are made one new man.

intro: Deacon Malachi takes the week the United States government's partners bought TikTok and shows the great mouth and the eyes of a man from Daniel 7 as the technology of the last beast. From the telegraph and radio to television, the internet and social media, the mouth of the beast speaks to the whole world, deceives with its wonders, and watches everyone. With a run of clips on surveillance tools, censorship of the word Zionist and the ADL's monitoring, the class shows the wicked watching the righteous as the Psalms describe, and ends with the promise that God disappoints the devices of the…

title: My Temple My Choice
intro: Captain Gideon teaches that keeping the dietary law means more than avoiding the unclean animals of Leviticus 11. Overeating, constant snacking and a diet built on sugar are sins against the body, and the class names them plainly. Those who call such teaching bullying are the people Isaiah describes, who want smooth things. The class moves from Deuteronomy 30:19, choose life, through the case against pork and bottom feeders, to Sirach 37 and 31 on excess and moderate eating, and ends with exercise, raising children to eat well, and asking God for the spirit of discipline.

intro: Captain Zakar teaches from IUIC Oklahoma City, with Captain AZ, Captain Noah, Officer Ari and later Captain Paloo beside him. After opening with the history of how Constantine and the Council of Laodicea turned the Sabbath into Sunday, and how late Christianity reached Ethiopia, the class defines pride and shows it as the root of every fall: pride is departing from your maker, it is first on God's list of hates, and it destroyed the northern kingdom, Judah, Assyria, Nebuchadnezzar, Antiochus and Herod. title: The Dividing Hatred: Cornelius the Centurion
intro: This class sets out to settle who Cornelius the centurion was. It traces the split between Judah and Ephraim from Solomon's strange wives to Jeroboam's golden calves, and shows how God said through Hosea that the northern kingdom would be not a people. Judah then treated the northern tribes as Gentiles, strangers and unclean, while the prophets promised the two houses would be joined again. Hezekiah's Passover, where unclean men of Ephraim and Manasseh were pardoned and healed, is the key to Peter's vision. It will make the nations drink oppression until Europe and the nations hate it and burn it. The teacher also turns to the immigration raids: Aquila and Priscilla were deported from Rome and still became Paul's helpers, so Israel must not fear. Isaiah 19 foretells Egyptian against Egyptian, and the rest of the class traces how America's founders wrote the Second Amendment for a militia against tyranny. Secession talk, a cruel…

Esau is a nation of fierce countenance that spares no one who looks like Israel. The Latinos are Israelites, the Ladinos or Latinized Negroes of Portuguese history. Asher's blessing of children, oil and iron fits South America. Lamentations 5 describes their captivity, and Esau, the red and hairy hunter who lives by the sword, is the predator in the title. He is the man of sin now being revealed, and he will be broken without hand when…

title: Pattern
intro: A teacher back in the front of the class after a fall speaks from his own trial. The pattern of the world is death, and the pattern Israel must keep is faith: meditate on the law day and night, examine yourself, know your own weak points, and never give up your place in the work. He answers brothers who would hand back their rank over bills or affliction with the parable of the sower, Christ's prayer in John 17 and David's broken and contrite heart in Psalm 51. intro: Deacon Yashua traces the spirit of Cain, the son of perdition, from the first murder to the United States. Cain's hatred and deceit, Tubal-cain's weapons and Lamech's boast pass into Esau, who lives by the sword and waits to kill his brother. The same pattern shows today: America labels a leader a drug lord, strips him of legitimacy, sanctions and isolates his country, then removes him, as it did to Maduro. The class sets this beside the merchants of Revelation 18 and the School of the Americas. It shows how the northern kingdom in Latin America was mixed and whitened, and ends on the promise…

title: Donald Trump: the Sword of God
intro: This class reads Donald Trump as the sword of God: a king whose heart the Lord turns wherever he wills to judge the nations. The truth that makes Israel free says a day is coming that burns as an oven, and it will not come until the man of sin, America, is revealed. America threatens Iran, seizes Venezuela, eyes Greenland and bombs nations across the earth, and the class matches this with Psalm 10, Isaiah 14 and Isaiah 47. The Lord's long-suffering is the only reason Israel has not been swallowed by the nations, and he calls every Israelite to repent and gather. The sword then turns on…

The law of two witnesses forbids slander and false witness, and the class warns those who spread lies about the ministry. Christ sent the seventy out two by two to bind and loose. title: War of the Gods
intro: The class answers those who see a war of the gods. The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob is God of gods, a man of war who creates peace and evil, and who teaches his soldiers to war. He left the nations in Canaan so each generation of Israel would learn war, and he gave Joshua a strategy at Ai that won only through obedience. Christ created the principalities and powers Israel wrestles against. The real war is spiritual: against the image of a corruptible man and the stories built around it, and against Edom, who says 'I am a god' and trusts in the smith and the waster God created. title: Christ: the Enemy of Christianity
intro: Bishop Nathanyel shows that Christianity is the false prophet and that the true Christ is its enemy. America is the second beast of Revelation 13, horns like a lamb and speaking as a dragon. It called down fire from heaven on Hiroshima and Nagasaki and gave life to an image of the beast, Caesar Borgia's face sold as Jesus. The mark of the beast is sin made law, enforced through control of buying and selling. The class traces Esau-Edom from Mount Seir to the European powers, who hold Israel's land and call themselves Jews. It warns of a seducing spirit that will draw idle Israelites back into…

It then turns to America's hegemony. Revelation 17 shows the ten horns, Europe, giving their power to the beast after 1945 through NATO. They will one day hate the whore and burn her. intro: Captain Shem teaches that the highway of the upright is the strait path of keeping the commandments. It is difficult by design and full of obstacles, and at its centre is the family God ordered: Christ the head of the man, the man the head of the woman. He shows how Black and Latino marriage held strong through slavery and Jim Crow, then collapsed after 1965. Some have a house-servant spirit that wants the enemy to share in Israel's salvation and fights for the heathen to rule over them. The class follows the pattern from the adversaries who tried to join the temple building to the ungodly Israelites of the Maccabees, the Herodians and the rulers who said 'we have no king but Caesar.' Every sin followed the break between Adam and Eve, and the first organization of a nation is a husband and wife in God's order. The teachers show from paintings, histories and old maps that Black Israelites were given as gifts and servants across Europe and Asia. intro: Taught on the eve of the Roman new year, this class shows that God set the year to begin in the spring, while Rome changed times and laws. The months still carry Roman gods and numbers that no longer fit. Revelation 13's beast, America, inherited that power and was given to make war with the saints. The class warns young Israelite camps against fear, new Bibles, 'good nations' and books like Enoch. title: Pope Nicholas & the Moors of Spain
intro: A class on Revelation 13 read against the history of the Moors of Spain and the Christian slave trade that followed their fall. The beast from the sea is a race of men, its heads and horns the European nations, and Rome's deadly wound was an African emperor on its throne. Dictionaries define the Moor as a negro and a blackamoor, and paintings show Moors in royal dress before 711 turned to captivity. Portugal shipped Jewish children to São Tomé, Europe gave Black servants as gifts, and Sinterklaas still parades a blackened helper. The class then turns to the true calendar, the moon as the sign…

title: Political Power Under Darkness
intro: A class on political power in a world given into the hand of the wicked. The war is against spiritual wickedness in high places, and the system of America was never built for the children of slaves. God rules in the kingdom of men and sets up the basest of men, and Israel was told to set a king only from among its brethren. The class looks at Black public figures who praise the administration, a famous athlete marrying outside the nation, and the Christmas Day strikes on Nigeria sold as the defence of Christians. title: Transforming from Immorality into Beautiful Civility Part 2
intro: Part two of the series on turning from immorality back to civility, centred on marriage as the crown of a civilised nation. Bishop Yawasap opens on the idols of the nations and the tree of Jeremiah 10, then shows how Satan went to Eve first and still uses the woman to keep the man subdued. Slavery stripped fathers from the home and broke the family on purpose. The class turns to the fear of God as the whole duty of man, the beauty that deceives in Judith and Proverbs, the narrow path of 2 Esdras, and the man who rules his own house. title: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World
intro: A marathon class on the kingdom of Adam and the old world before the fall. It opens by setting aside Christmas as a Jewish fable, showing that Christ was born and died at Passover. The teacher then argues that Moses hid the secrets of wisdom in similitudes, so Genesis 1 describes more than the making of the sky and the sea. The first light is Christ, the dividing of light from darkness is the choosing of the children of light, and paradise was made on the second day before the earth. title: Jubilee: The Year To Be Set Free
intro: A class on the seventh-year release and the year of Jubilee, the law that kept any Israelite from staying poor or enslaved forever. The Sabbath of the land rested the fields every seventh year, cancelled debts between brethren, and freed Hebrew servants. Every fiftieth year, from the Day of Atonement, land returned to the family and tribe. The class sets that servitude against the chattel slavery of the nations, answers the verses used to call the Bible a slave book, and follows Israel's broken covenants in Jeremiah 34 and Nehemiah 5. title: Babylon Speaks Plainly: Venezuela and the Real WMD
intro: Deacon Yashua reads the pressure on Venezuela through Habakkuk 2, Micah 2 and Revelation 18. America is modern Babylon, the proud man who gathers all nations and is never satisfied. The class looks at the strikes on boats in the Caribbean, the order classing fentanyl as a weapon of mass destruction, and the claim that Venezuela 'stole' American oil. It sets them beside Iraq, the scriptures on crafty counsel, and those who covet fields and take them by violence. It then explains how Bretton Woods and the dollar made the United States the world's banker, why Israel in the Americas and Africa…

title: Christmas/ Icons, Idolatry, White Supremacy !!revealed!!
intro: A hidden-history class on how the Renaissance, the revival of Greco-Roman culture, whitewashed the image of Christ and the prophets. The teacher reads from Wikipedia on the Renaissance, humanism and 'Western culture,' then shows centuries of Byzantine, Coptic and Russian icons of a Black Christ, Black apostles, Black Job and David, and a Black St. Nicholas. It shows how later painters went over those images. Revelation 13 is read as the European beast and America its image, and Jeremiah 10 as the Christmas tree itself, a sacred tree from Assyria to Germanic paganism. The class closes on Black…

title: Kill Or Be Killed
intro: A class on the war inside every Israelite. The title does not mean carnal weapons: either you kill the old man that still reigns in your members, or you will be killed serving him. The teacher starts from John 8:32 and 2 Corinthians 13:5. Know yourself and be honest about your hang-ups, because the enemy within is more deadly than any nation. The class works through the fear of the Lord that hates pride and the froward mouth, lust and covetousness, and Ezra's warning about the mixed holy seed. James 4 on wars that come from lusts leads to the renewing of the mind in Ephesians 4, and the class…

title: The Gospel Is Black Liberation
intro: The gospel is the good news of black liberation. Gospel is the Old English god spell, God's story, and the Bible's own word for it is glad tidings. Today's class will upset many Christians, because what Isaiah and Christ said the good news was sent to do was never sent to everybody on the planet. It was sent to the meek, the brokenhearted, the captive, the imprisoned and the bound, and that is black, Latino, Native American Indian and our people in the Pacific.

title: The Beauty in Civility the Cost of Immorality
intro: What our own immorality costs us, taught as part one of two: the cost first, the beauty of civility to follow. Years of sitting in judgments and counsellings put the pattern together, and the thread running through the whole lesson is that righteous anger is what gets sin out from among us, because the hell we are catching is our own doing and not the white man's.

title: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel
intro: Good intentions, but bad judgment. When a man says he had good intentions, that is not him being good: a lot of the time it is the cover for the folly and the foolishness he was already doing, and the escape route he keeps for when things fall apart. Before the topic, the folly of Benjamin in these churches and what the pastors are doing to our people.

title: Radicalize The Youth
intro: The class is for the young men and young women of the congregation, called to the front of the building because they are the ones who carry this truth after the older men are gone. To radicalize is to hold extreme views, the polar opposite of the world, and the class lays out what has to go into a young mind for that to hold: whose image he is made in, who his enemies are, what is waiting at the end of it, and the older men's duty to put it there.

title: The Mind of Mattathias: Let's Search the Scriptures
intro: The feast of dedication is a feast of overcoming our oppressors through war, and the men of Israel have to meet it with the mind of a warrior, in battle mode. The class walks the history of war in the scriptures — the armies numbered inside every tribe, Gideon's three hundred, Ehud, Shamgar, Judith — and lands on Mattathias, the Levite father of Judas Maccabeus, whose mind set the revolt in motion because he knew his forefathers' history and used it to hold his five sons and his people together. The charge running through all of it is against the victim mind and against men who are not fit…

title: To Whom Much Is Given: The Burden and Beauty of Godly Leadership
intro: What the crown of leadership actually weighs — a condensed follow-on to the "heavy is the head" class he gave on the Phoenix page a couple of new moons back. He chose it for the feast of dedication because the history of our forefathers under the Maccabees shows every layer of leadership at once: bold and courageous men, the burdens they carried, and the traitors and hypocrites among our own. The first half lays out five burdens every leader bears; the second turns to the home, because the house a man rules is the first congregation he will ever lead.

title: When the Cup Becomes a Chain: Drunk in Bondage
intro: Alcohol, and the comfort we go to it for. He had been watching the camp's classes on alcoholism and saw that they get the fewest views of anything in the library, because our people do not watch what holds them accountable -- so he taught it again as a self-evaluation: where the comfort is supposed to come from, what the scriptures call drunkenness, the four stages of alcoholism and what moderation actually means. The cup becomes a chain when it is the thing you reach for to keep from feeling what you have been through.

title: CHRIST: ISRAEL'S LAST TEMPLE
intro: The fourth day of the Feast of Dedication and a new moon, and the class he had planned never got taught. He spent the time motivating the men instead: the Feast of Dedication is the warriors' feast, so he opened the Maccabees on zeal for the law, answered the Christian apologists coming at the camp, and showed from the prophets and from Christ at the feast of the dedication that the holy days were never done away with. What he named the class for, Christ as Israel's last temple and the sacrifices he replaced, he reached only at the end, and he said he would do a part two.

title: Matthew 25:1-12 | Excerpt from 'The Negro Bible: The Making Of A Slave'
intro: The parable of the ten virgins, broken down verse by verse: the virgins are the hundred and forty-four thousand of the twelve tribes, the lamps are the commandments, the oil is the understanding, and the five that are shut out are the ones who prophesied in the name without keeping the law. The lesson closes in Allen H. Godbey's The Lost Tribes a Myth, on the Judaism found among West Africans and among the slaves brought to America.

title: Black Christians Stuck in Delusional Orbiting Cycles of Stupidity
intro: Why the black Christian church is stuck in a delusional orbiting cycle of stupidity: 2 Thessalonians 2 says God sends a strong delusion to the people who received not the love of the truth, and the truth is the law. Taught at the Thanksgiving and Christmas season to put strength into anybody new in the truth whose family and job are pulling them back, and to answer the apologetics who want to debate the trinity and the law instead of the colour of Christ and who the real Jews are.

title: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife
intro: He had a part two on the fall of Lucifer, which is Babylon, which is America, ready to go, but the spirit took him somewhere else: marriage, and the signs of a good wife. He deals first with the sins our people are falling into, fornication above all, and with what makes a marriage honorable or dishonorable from the day it is made; then he lays out what a good wife is, because in order for the nation of Israel to be strong the family has to be strong.

title: Escape Thankskilling : Oh God & My Lord
intro: A precept-upon-precept class on the divinity of Christ: that the Father made the Son first and used him to make everything, breathed him into Adam, brought him through David's line and gave him Israel as his firstborn, his children and his wife, so that he is both our God and our Lord. It opens with a long answer to the doctrine going round Israel that the nations can be saved, and to the brothers calling Paul a false prophet.

title: Ezekiel 37:1-11 | Excerpt from “The 4 Temples of Jerusalem”
intro: A verse-by-verse breakdown of Ezekiel's valley of dry bones: who the bones are, what the breath in them is, and why the house of Israel gathering as Christians and as Muslims has no life in it. Revelation 11 and Ephesians 2 are set beside the vision as the same prophecy.

title: The Fallacy of Black Christians
intro: A class on the fallacy of black Christianity: where the Catholic and Protestant churches came from, who put the white image of Christ in the earth, and why the people who hold to it mourn for the oppressor and never for the oppressed. The class traces the religion from the silent era after the apostles to the Protestant Reformation and the slave trade, answers the urban apologists from the scriptures on enemies and salvation, and ends on the prophecy of Hosea and the pure language God gives Israel.

title: Book of Our Fathers: Who’s Who Part 3
intro: Part three of Book of Our Fathers, the who's who of the Bible: Joshua, Caleb, the judges and Samuel, each one named with his tribe, his birth, his battles and the point of his life. It opens on why our people were cut off from this heritage and who went to great lengths to hide it, then walks Ecclesiasticus 46 figure by figure out of the histories.

title: Living a Clean Life in a Dirty World
intro: A class on living a clean life in a dirty world: the call of Revelation 18 to come out of her is a call out of America's sins, her politics, her religion and her holidays, and the class walks the scriptures that say how it is done — a mind renewed, the old man put off, the life cleansed and sanctified, and a walk kept in the spirit. Thanksgiving is a week away, and the pressure the holidays put on a young man in his parents' house is dealt with head on.

title: Mind Control & The Power Of Prayer
intro: A class on mind control and the power of prayer: we think we have free will, but every decision we make has been filtered through something or somebody, and a man is either doing the work of the Lord or the work of Satan. The first part walks how our minds are taken — Willie Lynch, the welfare system, television, social media, the music, the white image of Christ and the pastors who feed themselves — and the second part shows the answer the scriptures give: a mind rooted in this Bible, and prayer the Most High hears and answers.
